title: Why British Feet Grew Longer And Wider
hook: British feet changed shape as adult bodies became heavier.
closing: Your old shoe size may no longer match the shape of your feet.
question: Has your shoe size changed?

segments.say: British men's average shoe size rose from 8 to 10. Feet grew longer across a generation.
Sixty-seven percent of British women say their feet widened as adults. Growth changed shape as well as length.
Sixty-six percent of adults in England are overweight or obese. More body weight can spread the foot.
